summary: Allow committed-height consensus queries during normal indexer and balance-history catch-up
details: Historical state, contextual pass and economic queries validate committed height and exact state identity independently of global consensus_ready. Pending publication, recovery, shutdown, missing history and identity mismatches still block; completion rechecks safety and identity.

Mining preflight and status accept pinned candidates during ordinary catch-up while preserving Bitcoin startup, reorg epoch and identity checks. Global synchronization readiness retains its existing meaning.

This stage does not add Go deferred block validation or a miner publication gap, and does not guarantee availability during cross-store block commits. No protocol, genesis or database format changes are required.
